original_test_intent: Verify `PWR_GB_GPU1` through `PWR_GB_GPU8` are eight GPU-baseboard power telemetry records individually displayed in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, with correct physical GPU identity, electrical measurement boundary, watts or other defined units, status and supported thresholds for the recorded operating state.
original_method: Confirm the non-`_M` family meaning, bind each index to physical GPU, UUID/BDF and exact board power-monitor field, then compare complete passive raw/UI values with boundary- and state-specific limits using synchronized workload, power-policy and averaging-window evidence. Preserve GPU and BMC state.
manual_activity: The GPU/power owner defines the non-M measurement boundary, maps GPU1-8 to physical positions and stable UUID/BDF identities, identifies each board-monitor channel and supplies state-specific limits. Automation can collect passive BMC/GPU inventory and UI data; a human confirms operating context and owns the verdict. No GPU workload or power-policy change is authorized.
required_inputs: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and non-M versus `_M` family definition
Per-index physical position, GPU PN/serial/UUID/BDF/VBIOS/FW and present/powered state
Per-sensor electrical boundary, quantity/units and power-monitor controller/bus/mux/address/channel/register
Scaling, accuracy, averaging/integration window, polling and time-alignment rules
Stable SDR and UI identities plus boundary-specific tolerance, limits, thresholds/hysteresis, status and unavailable/stale rules
Recorded driver/persistence state, clocks, power cap, processes/workload, fan/inlet/airflow and optional equivalent GPU telemetry field
Validated protected ipmitool/API/browser access and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, kernel, NVIDIA XID or power/thermal logs; existing state is relevant evidence.
Do not issue `sensor get 'PWR_GB_GPU1~8'` as a wildcard. Resolve and query eight exact records separately.
Do not map GPU number from `nvidia-smi` index or BDF order without the approved physical/UUID topology, and do not merge this family with `_M`.

Do not compare board input with GPU device power unless electrical boundary and synchronized integration window equivalence are approved; instantaneous readings from different sources can legitimately differ.
Do not start GPU workload, change persistence/clocks/power caps, reset/power-cycle/reseat GPUs, alter thresholds or flash firmware. Record the current passive condition.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script. Stop without automatic retry on missing/swapped GPUs, stale data or BMC/UI/GPU disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the non-M family, eight-GPU physical/UUID/BDF and monitor-channel map, target, client, vendor reference and Script; build an eight-row expectation matrix.
Retrieve each record separately with full SDR/controller identity, electrical boundary, value, units, threshold capability, status, averaging window and timestamp; capture each unchanged UI row.
Record simultaneous GPU inventory, power state, clocks/cap, processes/workload and cooling; compare approved equivalent telemetry only after boundary and time-window alignment.
Preserve raw/redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, GPU load/policy/cap/clock/reset/power/service, threshold/firmware change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Define the non-M family and approve GPU1-8 physical/stable identity and board-monitor source map, separate from `_M`.
Provide boundary-specific scaling/window, tolerance, limits/thresholds, status/freshness and absent/powered-off rules; approve any telemetry equivalence and tool/Script.
Review all eight GPUs independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting aggregate, device-versus-board or `_M` readings.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as written because tilde shorthand is not an IPMI wildcard and one response cannot prove eight records. It omits stable GPU, electrical-boundary, monitor-source and sampling-window mapping; its fallback is truncated, credential-exposing and cipher-assumptive.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate eight exact non-M records, bind each to physical GPU and board monitor field, query through protected read-only access, and correlate complete synchronized UI and state evidence with the boundary-specific specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_GB_GPU1~8, both WebUI paths, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the range without editing Master or creating GPU load.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an eight-row matrix keyed by physical GPU, UUID/BDF and board-monitor channel, document electrical boundary and integration window, then compare complete raw/API and UI fields with boundary-specific rules under synchronized passive GPU state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact eight-GPU baseboard population and BMC/power-monitor/SDR/WebUI implementation documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/GPU-baseboard, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, GPU VBIOS/FW/driver, monitor firmware, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: GPU-baseboard power tree and index map, GPU inventory, monitor-controller specification, BMC SDR/telemetry definition, GPU power-policy recipe and WebUI schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves a range into eight stable GPU and electrical-boundary-bound records and adds synchronized state/window evidence while preserving passive display coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static power display does not validate workload response, performance per watt, power-cap enforcement, rail transients, protection, threshold events, shutdown or `_M`-family semantics.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Non-M boundary definition, eight-GPU/monitor map, state-specific acceptance, synchronized passive timing, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU enumeration is unstable; BMC board power and NVIDIA device power can differ by auxiliary losses, sampling interval and boundary, and powered-off devices may report zero or unavailable by design.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM, monitor-vendor or NVIDIA telemetry as an approved alternative/corroboration only while preserving the original ipmitool method, recording interface/version/boundary/window and reason, obtaining engineer approval and proving equivalent separate GPU1-8 identity, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. `_M` or aggregate GPU power is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard/BIOS/BMC identity and eight-row physical position, GPU PN/serial/UUID/BDF/VBIOS/FW/presence/power-state map
Non-M family definition plus per-GPU electrical boundary and monitor controller/bus/mux/address/channel/register/scaling/window map
Complete separate raw values with stable IDs, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and synchronized timestamps plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health rows
Recorded driver/persistence/clocks/cap/processes/workload, fan/inlet/airflow and boundary/time-aligned Project/vendor comparison with any approved telemetry equivalence

Explicit missing/swapped/powered-off/stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script/tool evidence, no-clear/no-load-or-policy-change/no-retry proof, final GPU/BMC health and engineer-owned eight-GPU verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The range and electrical boundary are underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive display/specification validation of eight GPU power records. Project definition separates non-M from `_M`; this is readiness rather than a purpose conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eight-GPU passive power-display purpose is identifiable. Project topology and power-monitor documentation can provide the boundary and acceptance, so missing inputs do not make the review permanently BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range query, unstable GPU index, wrong electrical boundary or `_M` value from being presented as eight non-M GPU power records, and prevents workload or power-cap changes from being added to a passive test.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU power is only comparable when identity, electrical boundary and averaging window are aligned. A BMC board monitor can include conversion or auxiliary losses not present in device telemetry, so numeric similarity is not proof. Eight passive records must be UUID/topology-bound, and this UI row cannot authorize load or power-policy changes.
